ownerStory.introTitle: From the green gardens of Ben Tre.
ownerStory.introDescription: Ngoc Ngan Ben Tre is a seedling business from Ben Tre — a land known for lush gardens and traditional farming. Driven by a love of plants and a wish to bring quality varieties to growers, Ngoc Ngan has dedicated the work to selling and supplying seedlings to customers near and far.
ownerStory.introImageAlt: Cai Mon Ben Tre seedlings with guava and durian
ownerStory.journeyParagraph1: From the smallest seedlings, Ngoc Ngan carefully chooses plants that are healthy, true to variety, and suited to each customer’s needs. As the old saying goes: “With enough work grinding iron, one day it becomes a needle.” Building a lasting business likewise takes persistence, diligence, and trust.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph2: Beyond selling seedlings, Ngoc Ngan shares planting and care experience so customers gain practical knowledge for their gardens. For growers, the proverb “First water, second fertilizer, third diligence, fourth variety” remains valuable wisdom — a reminder that many factors must work together for plants to thrive.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph3: Through direct sales and social media, Ngoc Ngan gradually brings Ben Tre seedlings to plant lovers and gardeners. With dedication and a spirit of continuous learning, Ngoc Ngan aims to keep building reputation, raising seedling quality, and helping create greener gardens.
ownerStory.journeyImageAlt: Ngoc Ngan Ben Tre packing healthy seedlings for delivery

ownerPhilosophy.title: Honor the land, love what you grow.
ownerPhilosophy.description: As the familiar folk verse says: “Dear friend, do not leave fields fallow — every inch of land is an inch of gold.” That is the spirit Ngoc Ngan wants to share: respect the land, love the crops, and work with farmers to create lasting value from the gardens of home.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Answers about our Cai Mon seedlings, ordering, delivery, payment, and caring for your plants once they arrive.

contact.title: Still have questions?
contact.description: Message us on Zalo and we will help you pick the variety that suits your soil and your garden.

placeOrder.question: How do I place an order?
placeOrder.answer: Pick a plant on the homepage, choose a size if options are offered, add it to your cart, and go to checkout. All we need is your phone number, name, and delivery address. You can also order directly through Zalo at 0386569374.

noAccount.question: Do I need an account to order?
noAccount.answer: No. You can order without signing up — just your phone number, name, and address so we can confirm the order and deliver your plants.

orderConfirmation.question: How do I know my order went through?
orderConfirmation.answer: You will see your order number on the confirmation screen right after checkout. We then call or message you on Zalo to confirm the varieties, quantity, and address before shipping.

changeOrder.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
changeOrder.answer: Yes, as long as the order has not been packed and shipped. Message us on Zalo at 0386569374 with your order number as soon as possible and we will update it.

multiplePlants.question: Can I order several plants at once?
multiplePlants.answer: Yes. Add as many plants as you like and check out in a single order. Combining plants into one order also keeps shipping costs down.

deliveryTime.question: How long does delivery take?
deliveryTime.answer: Plants ship with Vietnam Post or J&T Express and usually arrive within 3–5 business days. Northern provinces and remote areas may take one or two days longer.

shippingCost.question: How much is shipping?
shippingCost.answer: Orders of $20 or more ship free. Below that there is a flat $8 fee, shown in the order summary before you place the order.

nationwide.question: Do you ship nationwide?
nationwide.answer: Yes. We ship to every province in Vietnam through Vietnam Post and J&T Express. Just give us a full address including street, ward, district, and province.

packaging.question: How are plants packed for shipping?
packaging.answer: The root ball is wrapped to hold moisture and keep the soil intact, the branches are tied, and everything travels in a ventilated box. This keeps the plant healthy through 3–5 days in transit.

trackOrder.question: How can I track my order?
trackOrder.answer: Once your order ships we send the tracking number on Zalo so you can follow it on the Vietnam Post or J&T Express website.

afterDelivery.question: What should I do when the plant arrives?
afterDelivery.answer: Unbox it right away, remove the ties, place it somewhere shaded with gentle sun, and water the root ball. Let the plant rest for 3–5 days to adjust before planting it out or repotting.

watering.question: How often should I water?
watering.answer: Water when the top of the root ball feels dry — usually once a day in the early morning or late afternoon, and less in the rainy season. Good drainage matters most: young plants are far more likely to die from waterlogging than from thirst.

planting.question: Should I plant in the ground or in a pot?
planting.answer: Fruit trees do best planted in the ground, but a large, well-draining pot works too. Mix the soil with well-rotted compost and choose a spot that gets at least 5–6 hours of sun a day.

losingLeaves.question: Is it normal for leaves to drop after delivery?
losingLeaves.answer: Yes, some leaf drop after transit is expected, and new shoots usually appear within one or two weeks as the roots settle. Keep the soil evenly moist, shade the plant from harsh sun, and hold off on fertiliser. If the plant wilts fast or the stem darkens, send us photos on Zalo.

fruiting.question: How long until the tree bears fruit?
fruiting.answer: It depends on the variety and how it is cared for. Grafted trees usually fruit within one to two years, much sooner than seed-grown trees. Message us on Zalo for the timeline of a specific variety.

graftedSeedlings.question: Are the plants true to variety?
graftedSeedlings.answer: Yes. We source from nurseries we know in Cai Mon – Cho Lach, mostly grafted plants, so they keep the parent tree's fruit quality, yield, and time to harvest.

plantSize.question: How tall are the seedlings?
plantSize.answer: It varies by variety, but most seedlings are around 40–80cm tall when they ship. Exact height and details are listed in each plant's description.

potSize.question: Can I choose the plant size?
potSize.answer: Yes. Where size options are offered, you can choose one on the product page before adding the plant to your cart. The price updates to match the size you pick.

plantsWithPots.question: Do plants come with a pot?
plantsWithPots.answer: Seedlings ship in their nursery root ball rather than a decorative pot, which keeps them light and safe in transit. You can plant them straight into the ground or pot them up yourself.

returnPolicy.question: What is your return policy?
returnPolicy.answer: Because plants are living products, we cannot take back healthy plants. If something is wrong with your order, message us on Zalo within 48 hours of delivery and we will sort it out.

damagedPlant.question: What if my plant arrives broken or damaged?
damagedPlant.answer: Photograph the plant and the box as soon as you open it and send the photos on Zalo within 48 hours. If the damage happened in transit, we will send a replacement or refund that plant.

exchangePlant.question: Can I swap for a different variety?
exchangePlant.answer: We can swap varieties while the order is still with us. After delivery it depends on the condition of the plant and what is in stock — message us on Zalo and we will check.
